ValidationRule.description: If case reason is 'Denunciation', the case must have an Anonymous Account
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", TEXT($User.UserType) <> "AutomatedProcess",
OR ( AND ( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Latam_Non_Quality", ISPICKVAL(Reason, "Denunciation (NQC)"), ISBLANK( Account.Id ) ), AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Latam_Non_Quality", ISPICKVAL(Reason, "Denunciation (NQC)"), NOT (Account.Anonymous_Consumer__c) ) ))
